extensionDescription.message: Live Binance/OKX copy-trader risk analysis from the current lead page.

popupUsageBody.message: Open a Binance or OKX lead-trader detail page. The analysis panel appears automatically and computes risk locally from data visible to your current browser session.

popupCheckMartingale.message: Martingale-like adverse adds and long loss holds

popupCheckMargin.message: Loss-period capital injections and current floating-loss risk

popupCheckPayoff.message: Payoff ratio, expectancy, sample size, and MDD

popupCheckScalping.message: Slippage and copyability risk in high-frequency micro-profit strategies

popupPrivacyBody.message: No collection, upload, storage of cookies, headers, API keys, or account data. There is no backend service.

settingNoCopyExisting.message: Do not copy existing positions; wait for the next new entry.

settingSmallRatio.message: If you still want to test it, use a small fixed-ratio allocation and an account-level stop loss.

settingHighMdd.message: MDD is high; avoid oversizing a single lead trader.

settingDefault.message: Use fixed-ratio copy, avoid copying existing positions, and set an account-level stop loss.

loadingText.message: Fetching current public/session-visible data and analyzing locally. Temporary busy pages are retried until complete.

noMajorRisks.message: No major risk rule triggered, but this does not mean the trader is safe or profitable.

noPositives.message: Not enough positive evidence yet; observe more samples first.

disclaimer.message: This analysis only uses data available to the current browser session and computes locally. It is not investment advice and does not guarantee profit or safety.

familyInsufficient.message: Not enough trade history to judge copy risk

familyNoMajorPattern.message: No obvious high-risk trading pattern detected

familyMartingale.message: Martingale: increases size while losing, so consecutive wrong-way moves can expand drawdown quickly

familyGrid.message: Grid / range trading: layered orders harvest chop, but one-way trends can build floating loss

familyDcaLeft.message: DCA / left-side trading: averages into weakness, so early entries can inherit drawdown

familyRightTrend.message: Right-side / trend following: enters after confirmation and usually depends on cleaner stops

familyScalping.message: Scalping: short-duration small profits, so copier latency and fees matter

familyMarketMaking.message: Market-making / high-frequency making tendency: many short trades where copy slippage can erase edge

familySwing.message: Swing trading: longer holds, so copiers may inherit open-position volatility

familyMeanReversionStop.message: Left-side rebound trading with fast stops: execution quality matters

familyBatchScalping.message: Scalping: short-duration small profits, so copier latency and fees matter

familyLayeredMeanReversion.message: DCA / left-side trading: averages into weakness, so early entries can inherit drawdown

familyLowFreqSwing.message: Swing trading: longer holds, so copiers may inherit open-position volatility

labelHighWinTailRisk.message: High win rate may hide tail risk

verdictHighRiskAvoid.message: High risk; not suitable for normal copy trading

positiveDays.message: Trading days are about {0}, meeting the minimum 30-day observation threshold.

positiveClosedTrades.message: {0} closed trades are available, enough for an initial behavior read.

positivePayoff.message: Average payoff ratio is {0}, not a typical small-win/large-loss profile.

positiveLossHoldShort.message: Average losing trades are held for less time than winning trades, suggesting cleaner stop behavior.

cautionTooFewDays.message: Trading days are only {0}; this is below the minimum 30-day observation threshold.

cautionNoAllPeriodRoi.message: All-period ROI cannot be reconstructed reliably; do not rely only on a partial page window.

cautionReconstructedNeedsCompleteness.message: All-period ROI is reconstructed from available data; history completeness and starting point still matter.

cautionThinClosedTrades.message: Only {0} closed trades are available; one trade can heavily distort the conclusion.

cautionHighMdd.message: Visible/API MDD is about {0}; a new copier could immediately suffer a large drawdown.

cautionLongLossHold.message: The longest historical losing position was held for {0}, indicating dead-loss holding risk.

cautionPoorPayoff.message: Average payoff ratio is only {0}, meaning average losses are larger than average wins.

cautionNearPerfectWin.message: Win rate is near 100% with almost no realized losses; the strategy may not have been stress-tested.

cautionMicroProfit.message: High-frequency micro-profit strategies can be consumed by copy latency, slippage, and fees.

cautionAdverseAdd.message: Adverse add rate is about {0}; exposure grows when the market moves against the position.

cautionLossPeriodDeposit.message: Detected {0} capital injections during losing positions; copiers may not be able to add margin synchronously.

cautionFloatingLoss.message: Current positions show about {0} floating loss, roughly {1}% of lead capital.

cautionCopierDivergence.message: Lead ROI is positive, but copier PnL/AUM is about {0}; slippage, entry timing, or position management may diverge.

cautionCloseLeadCount.message: Historical closures: {0}. Old performance and current-round data may be disconnected.

evidenceLossDeposit.message: Capital injections during loss periods are one of the hardest risks for copiers to reproduce.

evidenceDestructiveMartingale.message: Adverse adds, delayed loss exits, or payoff imbalance appear together; martingale-like tail risk is high.

evidenceFloatingLoss.message: There is a material floating-loss position now; a new copier may inherit risk that was not theirs.

evidenceHugeMdd.message: Historical drawdown is very large. This only fits tiny speculative allocation, if any.
